description: Representative Madison Cawthorn (R-NC) today released the following statement endorsing Congresswoman Virginia Foxx (R-NC) for re-election to the United States House of Representatives in North Carolina’s 5th Congressional District in 2022.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Virginia Foxx for Congress
title: Madison Cawthorn Announces Endorsement of Virginia Foxx for Re-Election in 2022 - Virginia Foxx
